one_liner: Monitors the Atlantic testnet for large transfers and produces a ranked watch report — what moved, how much, from where, to where — labeled where known, never invented.
what_it_does: This lamp scans recent blocks for unusually large transfers and ranks them by size into a readable watch report. Parties are labeled only when the data supports it — never invented. Proven by 3 real transactions examined on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
